ownerReview: 接受 Phase 3a-B G-A8 正式 STOP 結果，選擇方案 A，但本輪先做有界限的平衡修正研究。
1. 保留已凍結版本 7a6e9736 與 G-A8 全部證據，不覆寫、不重新判定。
2. 優先診斷 hard_engage_stack、three_lane_pressure、classic.m6 的過強原因。先利用既有比賽、引擎機制及模板設定分析，確認是否有共同根因，不要直接盲調數值。
3. 根據診斷結果，事前登記一輪有限候選篩選，使用新的開發期 Seeds，交獨立 Reviewer 審查後執行。
4. 修正必須保留三個模板的核心玩法。尤其 three_lane_pressure 不能單純移除三路壓制來換取 PASS；classic.m6 只能做 v21 限定修正，v20 完全不變。
5. 同時分析 m5、m1、m3 接近 STOP 的風險，以及 defensive_hold 24.8% 對玩家體驗的影響，但不無限制擴充篩選。
6. 這輪以一次有界限的候選研究為上限。若找不到兼顧平衡與戰術特色的方案，停止並提出產品決策選項，不再自行追加下一輪。
Seeds 政策：43001–43400 已觀察，不可重作正式確認。新候選使用獨立、事前登記且去重的開發期 Seeds。其他尚未使用的正式保留 Seeds 全部保留。若未來修正語意，必須重新凍結並建立新的正式驗收登記。
本輪不重新凍結、不跑完整 P2、不重錄 Golden、不改發布門檻。保留 Challenge v21 STOP，兩個發布旗標關閉。不 Push、不 Deploy、不整合 main、不修改 CS。

seeds.rule: fresh block G-A8.fixScreen6 of tools/fixtures/study_seed_plan_3aB.json: development only, disjoint from every used or reserved block. Not 43001-43400 (observed), and none of the unused formal blocks 51001-55999, 66001-67200, 67501-68299, 65101-65500, which stay reserved. Screening seeds are never used to confirm a fix
seeds.whyN800: the earlier rounds used n=400, where the paired MDE is about 9.5 pp, larger than the 5 pp these fixes need. n=800 brings it to about 6.8 pp and the rate interval to about +/-3.4 pp. It is still not enough for a 5 pp effect: power at n=800 is about 55% for 5 pp, 70% for 6 pp, 83% for 7 pp; 80% power at 5 pp would need about 1,450 per arm. n is not raised: the study is bounded and a fresh confirmation is still required later

diagnosis: review/tactic-book-3a/3a-B_平衡修正研究.md section 2, from committed results and the engine, no match run. Across 42 template-block points the win rate relative to std correlates with aggression r=0.90 (R2 0.81), observational: aggression and risk correlate at r=0.93 and aggressive content comes with them, and the slope 5.9 pp per 0.1 is about five times the experimental one. The knob study on std content: +1.1 pp per +0.1 aggression (0.4..1.9), +1.5 pp per +0.1 risk (0.4..2.5), mostly from below neutral; above neutral the curve is close to flat and not monotonic. Direct arm: std content at 0.7 / 0.6 reads +5.0 (-1.3..+11.3). Knob-only fixes worked on one of five templates so far (m3, which started at 0.8 / 0.8). Win rate does not track kills: FULL m7 wins 67.3 with kill difference -1.92; on the risk scan kills fall while towers lost fall too, which points at map and tower hold. The engine has no per-tactic penalty term for these knobs, but real costs exist (recent-death block, team-behind shift, tower fire, kill gold, respawn). These are hypotheses for the arm list, not evidence of a fix

thresholds: the G-A8 rules, unchanged: STOP = win rate >= 0.60 and lower 95% bound > 0.55; WARN strong >= 0.57; WARN weak <= 0.43; control 0.50 +/- 0.05
selectionRule: unchanged from rounds 1-5: a candidate qualifies only inside the band 0.43 < win rate < 0.57; SELECTED = the first qualifying candidate in the listed order with 0.45 <= win rate <= 0.55; qualifying only in 0.43-0.45 or 0.55-0.57 => SELECTED_BORDERLINE; none => NO_CANDIDATE

listed order (listedOrder, asserted by V2), one knob per step: HE_R, HE_B, HE_C; TLP_R, TLP_E, TLP_F; M6_R, M6_B, M6_C; M5_A; M1_B. Fixed before the run. The first solid arm wins, so a small noise difference can pick the larger identity change; all arms are shown and the Owner sees it

SHOWS_IMPROVEMENT = paired vsBase upper 95% bound < 0, unadjusted. FIRST_DISTINGUISHED = the first candidate in the listed order with that property. The report also gives a Bonferroni label over the 11 candidates (|z| >= 2.84), descriptive only
BASE not reproduced on this block: the formal STOP stands regardless, so the candidate is still assessed (screenedCandidate, boundedOutcome). The formal G-A8 result is not re-judged

boundedOutcome, computed by the tool for each template, fixed before the run. REASONABLE = the screened candidate SHOWS_IMPROVEMENT, or FIRST_DISTINGUISHED is inside the band. If that arm is in ownerDecisionArms: REASONABLE_OWNER_DECISION. Otherwise IN_BAND_UNDISTINGUISHED when the screened candidate is in the band but the interval crosses 0 (lack of power, not proof of no effect), else NO_REASONABLE_CANDIDATE. A BORDERLINE arm always goes to the Owner as an explicit decision

study outcome: CANDIDATES_FOR_ALL_STOPS when all of stopTargets are REASONABLE; CANDIDATES_WITH_OWNER_DECISION when all are reasonable and at least one needs an owner decision arm; otherwise PRODUCT_DECISION_NEEDED, with the templates listed. INSTRUMENT (control out of range or more than 1% errors) or INCONCLUSIVE: stop and report. An out-of-range control is terminal for this block, because the seeds are deterministic. Whatever the outcome this is the last round; nothing is added after seeing data
the tool outcome is a proposal: an accepted candidate is a v21 fix candidate only, by Owner decision including its copy, and needs a new freeze and a new formal acceptance on fresh confirmation seeds
nearStopAnalysis: classic.m5, m1 and m3: BASE arms give a new read; the tool pools it with earlierReads, n-weighted (descriptive), and gives the chance of a STOP at n=400 as P(rate >= 0.60). M5_A and M1_B are one bounded arm each. classic.m3 gets no candidate: its frozen fix stays as it is
defensiveHoldAnalysis: no arm. Round 1 tried DH_A, DH_B and DH_C, none improved, but they never touched its defensive lanes or stances. Analysis only, from committed results: review/tactic-book-3a/3a-B_平衡修正研究.md section 3
report: per arm: win rate, 95% CI, G-A8 label, blue / red, STANDARD / SWAPPED, median duration, paired difference to STD; mechanism means (kill difference, gold lead at 10 and 20 min, towers taken and lost)
per candidate: paired difference to BASE with 95% CI, Bonferroni label (tool, |z| >= 2.84 over 11 candidates, descriptive), confirmation risks
per template: BASE against the formal result; verdict, screened candidate, boundedOutcome

multiplicity and power: 11 candidates on one block, unadjusted 95% intervals; paired sd about 0.69 gives an MDE of about 6.8 pp at n=800, so a NO_REASONABLE_CANDIDATE or IN_BAND_UNDISTINGUISHED can be a false negative and a SELECTED rate carries winner's curse. Stated before the run, from a Monte Carlo of this rule: P(CANDIDATES_FOR_ALL_STOPS) is about 0.41 under the doc's slopes, 0.93 under m3-like strong effects, 0.04 under m7-like weak effects, 0.00 under no effect. Screened rates run about 1.7-2.4 pp below the truth
